Only direct child SKILL.md files. Duplicate names and invalid files fail closed. Bounded UTF-8 text; model-disabled skills remain unavailable.

Explicit slash invocation and reattachment use exact authorized registration availability before deferred discovery; denied or shadowed skills remain unavailable. This is a local integration fix, not a claim of upstream equivalence.

Post-compaction restoration filters exact activated instruction content already present on the current surface, correlating successful Skill results separately from short activation notices. license: No new blanket license assigned. Source files have no embedded third-party notice. Existing dependency-specific notices and ownership decisions remain unchanged.
